title: Surreal Dream Shatter
description: A woman in a flowing peach gown stands on an ornate decaying staircase, reaching upward toward a beam of light. The ceiling has broken open revealing a surreal sky filled with floating picture frames, a melting clock, and furniture fragments against a purple and orange sunset.
prompt: A woman in an elegant peach Victorian gown stands on a grand decaying staircase inside a ruined mansion, reaching toward a powerful beam of light breaking through the shattered ceiling. The broken ceiling reveals a surreal purple and orange sky with floating picture frames, a melting clock like Dali, and scattered furniture. Ornate railings, faded murals on the walls, cinematic lighting, highly detailed surreal scene.
